Commentary.Commentary: Right! That ends the first ODI. A very close game but it should not have come this close. But when Pakistan plays, anything can happen. Bizarre things happened. It looked like Pakistan will win or will they choke? They did but somehow managed to cross the line. Do join us for the second game which starts on Sunday, 4th April 2021. The action will begin at 1000 local (0800 GMT). Now, we would like to bid goodbye from here. We need some time to recover from what we have witnessed. So, goodbye and take care!

Pakistan skipper, Babar Azam is also the Man Of The Match. He says that they wanted to restrict the South Africans to 270 and he is happy with the way the first Powerplay went. He further says that he told his bowlers to bowl the Test match length and not on the back of a length. He mentions that they got some early swing which they utilised that to good effect. He further says that they had p[lanned to stay as long as in the middle and he did exactly the same thing with Imam. He mentions that there was a bit of pressure when Nortje took 4 wickets but they would learn from it and come back stronger in the next game. He ends by saying that the win gives confidence to the team and they would look to win the second game and seal the series then and there itself.

South Africa skipper, Temba Bavuma says that it was not the result they wanted. He mentions that they were tested in both batting and bowling. He further says that they did not use the Powerplay too well while batting but the partnership between van der Dussen and Miller got them in. He also says that Babar and Imam took the game away from them. He mentions that they need to rectify their mistakes and look at the dismissals from this game and improve and tick all the boxes in the next game to win that one.

Earlier in the day, Pakistan asked South Africa to set a total. The visitors then thumped them early to leave them reeling at 55 for 4. Rassie van der Duseen then along with David Miller did the rescue act. The duo added 100-plus between them to get the South African innings on track. Miller departed after reaching his half-ton but Rassie continued. He played a magnificent knock of unbeaten 123 to help the side get over 270. For Pakistan, Afridi and Rauf picked up 2 but they were a bit expensive. Faheem bowled well but got 1 wicket in his 9-over spell. Shadab had a poor day as he failed to get the wickets that Pakistan needed in the middle overs. They eventually ended up conceding over 270. And then, on the last ball of the game, somehow managed to bag the win. Stay tuned for the presentations...

South Africa started well. They struck early and they kept things tight in Powerplay 1. However, once Babar and Imam got going, the Proteas looked clueless. And then Pakistan did what they do best. They collapsed. Quick wickets fell and Nortje was the man who was doing the trick. He took a 4-fer and forced Pakistan on the back foot. Rabada, Ngidi and Shamsi were superb in their spell after that and forced the game till the last over. Phehlukwayo struck in the final 2 overs but couldn't help the team win.

Chasing the total, Pakistan lost Fakhar early. Imam and Babar struggled to get going but they held on to their ends. They eventually got going. Babar raked up a fine half-ton and Imam followed him. They added 150-plus with Babar smashing a few glorious strokes on his way to his 13th Test ton. They looked all set to seal the deal but once Babar fell, Pakistan fluffed and lost 3 wickets in quick time. However, Rizwan along with Shadab calmed things down and added 50-plus. They both fluffed too. But Faheem somehow managed to win on the last ball of the game.

Rizwan and Shadab got together. They added 50-plus. It looked like these two will finally take Pakistan home. They will not give us those nervy moments. Rizwan decided to do the opposite. He went after a short ball and holed out. Shadab said 'I will do it.' But he didn't. He took the game close but fell in the 50th over. Faheem was injured. He played 3 dots but managed to seal the deal on the last ball.

What a game! A nerve-stopping one! How on earth can Pakistan get in a position like this. Why do they do it? This is just unbelievable. This is some finish to the ODI. Only Pakistan can get in trouble like this from a position where they could have sealed the game easily. But they are Pakistan. They do not like to do things straightforward. They were cruising when Imam and Babar were batting. But then they lost track. They kept losing track.

A single is taken!! Finally, we have a winner! What looked like a cakewalk turned out to be a moonwalk. Ashraf finally gets Pakistan over the line. Full and wide outside off, Ashraf throws the kitchen sink at it and slices the ball through covers to get the winning runs. PAKISTAN WIN BY 3 WICKETS!
Big meeting! The South African players get around Phehlukwayo. They discuss the plan.
Length and around off,  Ashraf lofts in the vacant area between mid on and mid off for a brace there.
And another dot! 3 off 2 needed! Short and outside off, Ashraf leaves thinking it as a wide but the umpire thinks otherwise.
Concussion test time! The physio is having a word with Faheem. Faheem looks fine though.
Short ball around middle, Ashraf goes for the pull but is beaten as he copes a blow onto his helmet.
Full on on off, drilled to mid off.
Who is in now? It is Shaheen Afridi. He will be on strike. A boundary will do for Pakistan.

OUT! CAUGHT! Rassie van der Dussen this time holds onto one! Slower and fuller around off, Khan looks to finish it off with a biggie but slices it high in the air. The ball goes to covers where Rassie van der Dussen takes it this time.
Edgy  but it gives three runs! Length and around off, Khan edges softly towards de Kock who fails to field it and the ball goes to fine leg. The batsmen take three valuable runs.
FOUR! Free Hit brings runs! Drilled! No one moved! Full and around off, Shadab drills it in the gap through mid off and covers to get a boundary.

BOWLED! Noooooo! Shadab Khan is not going anywhere. A high full toss from Ngidi Khan fails to negotiate it and the ball shatters the stumps there. South Africa are excited but Shadab is not going anywhere. The umpires check it upstairs and the third umpire rules it that it is above the waist height and it is a No Ball. Free Hit coming up.

What happened there? The zing bails light up and the South Africans celebrate. Shadab is not going anywhere. Is it over the waits? Looks like it. Yes. No ball called. What a game this is turning out to be.

DROPPED! Swirling catches are always difficult and Rassie van der Dussen spoils it. Slower and fuller, Khan slogs it but  gets the height there as Rassie van der Dussen runs ahead from the  deep and takes the catch but spills it to allow a brace there
Full and outside off, driven off the outside edge to third man for a single.
Another dot! Length and on leg, Ashraf goes for the pull but misses it. The umpire does not signal it as wide. It misses the stumps by a whisker there.
A dot! Short and on leg, Ashraf ducks under it. Ngidi gets away with this as the umpire signals one for the over.
14 needed in 12 balls. The game has turned on its head. Just amazing how Pakistan manages to get themselves in trouble.
Full on off, drilled down to long on for a single.
Short of a length and around off, Ashraf punches it on the up off the back foot but straight to covers.
Full on middle, Khan drives it to long on and gets a single.
Length and around off, eased down to the off side for a brace.
Who is in next? Faheem Ashraf joins Shadab Khan.

OUT! CAUGHT! South Africa have another one and Pakistan have made a mockery of this chase. They were in control when Babar and Imam were batting but after both of them departed it has been all downhill for them. Slower short ball around off, Rizwan targets the short boundary there as he goes for the slog but ends up hitting it straight to Rabada at deep mid-wicket who does not drop it.
Length and outside off, guided away to third man for a single. 18 in 17 needed.
Andile Phehlukwayo to bowl the 48th over of the match. 19 needed in 18 balls.
Full and on the pads, clipped to the leg side for another dot. 19 in 18 balls required by Pakistan to win.
Length and on leg, whipped away to the leg side for a dot.
Short of a length and around off, pulled to mid on for a single but then both the batsmen get back to their respective position as they abort the run.

Good running this! Length and around off, Khan guides it to backward point and takes a single. Miller thee misses his shy at the keeper's end but lack of back up means the batsmen get a brace extra so they get three in total.
Length and around off, worked to the leg side for a single. 22 in 22 needed more for Pakistan to win.
Full and on midlde, whipped away to deep mid-wicket for a couple now. 250 up for Pakistan now.
25 needed in 24 balls. Rabada is done. Nortje is done. Here's Ngidi.
Short of a good length around off, Khan blocks it off the back foot towards the off side. 25 in 24 is what Pakistan need now. This is going down the wire.
Length and around middle, clipped to mid-wicket by Khan there. 25 in 25 needed for a Pakistan win.
Good length and around off, Rizwan runs it down to deep point and gets a single. 25 in 26 needed more for Pakistan now.
Short of a length ball on middle, Rizwan works it to the leg side. 26 in 27 needed.
FOUR! Handy runs! Short and around midlde, sits up nicely for Rizwan who play the short-arm jab to get a boundary at deep backward square leg.
Beaten! Length and around off Rizwan gets sucked into poking at it but is lucky not to get an outside edge there.
Will Kagiso Rabada bowl out? Yes, he will.
Slower and fuller around off, whipped away to the leg side for a single. 30 in 30 needed.
Length and around off, tapped to backward point for a single. 31 in 31 is what Pakistan  need to go 1-0 in the series.
Length and around off, Shadab drives it to backward point now. 32 in 32 needed for Pakistan now.
Fuller and slower on middle worked to the leg side for a single. 32 needed in 33 balls.
Full again around off, driven to covers this time by Rizwan.
Full on off, Rizwan drives it hard and towards mid off.
Bowling change! Lungi Ngidi is back on. 7-1-45-0 are his numbers.
Length and on middle. Khan blocks it to the leg side. 33 in 36 needed for Pakistan now.
Short of a length ball, Rizwan guides it to third man for a single. 33 needed 37 balls.
Full on off, driven down to mid off now.
In the air... Just over! Length and on leg, Rizwan chips it towards mid on where it goes just over the fielder there and towards long on. A brace taken there.
Length and around off, driven straight to point.
Short of a length and around off, Rizwan blocks it to the off side and looks for a single  but is sent back in time by his partner.
Short and around middle, pulled to deep square leg for a brace. 36 more needed in 42 balls for Pakistan to win!
Good length  around off, punched off the back foot to the bowler.
Good length around off, Rizwan looks to clip it to the leg side but inside edges it onto his pads. He is ball searching but quickly gathers himself and gets a single.
FOUR! Drilled! Full and around off, Rizwan drives it down the ground and gets a boundary at long on now.
Good length and around leg, worked to the leg side for a single.
Length and on middle, clipped to deep square leg for a single.
SIX! Banged! Short again from Rabada and Shabdab pulls it flat behind square on the leg side for a biggie.
Length and around off, Khan taps it to point.
FOUR! Pulled away! Short and on middle, pulled away to deep square leg for a boundary. Just using the pace of the bowler there.
Full and around off, squeezed to deep point for a single.
Length and around off, Rizwan taps it to the off side now.
Length and around off, Rizwan defends it to the leg side.
Full around off, Khan taps it to the off side to see off the over.
Short of a good length and middle, pulled away to fine leg for a brace.
Full and around middle. stroked down to long on again for a single.
Full and around off, Shadab drives it to covers for a single.
Full on off, driven to long on for a single.
Full and around off, squeezed back to the bowler.
Powerplay 3 time! Now, the Proteas can place 5 fielders outside the 30-yard circle.
Full and around middle, Rizwan clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Clever batting! Short and outside off, Rizwan arches a bit and then uppercuts it over third man to get a boundary there.
Short of a length ball around off, Rizwan looks to defend it but the ball rears from there to ping Rizwan hard on the glove. Rizwan grimaces in pain there a bit
FOUR! This should get Rizwan going! Short and outside off, Rizwan swivels and then pulls it flat to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full and outside off,  Rizwan squeezes it to point.
Length and around off, Rizwan pats it to the off side.
Floated around middle, kept out. End of a fine over from Shamsi. Shortish and just outside off, pushed to point for nothing.
On off, kept out.
Floated on leg, Khan nudged it to the leg side.

NOT OUT! The dive saves Rizwan there. Loopy on leg, Rizwan clips it the leg side and comes searching down for a single but is sent back by his partner. The throw is a bit high for de Kock to collect and dislodge the bails.  Rizwan in the meantime makes it in with the dive. The replays and the third umpire confirm the same.
Run out appeal taken upstairs. Looks like Shadab is safe.
Loopy on middle, pushed back to the bowler off the front foot.
Floated on middle. clipped to square leg for a single.
Full and around off, Shadab looks to drive it but gets an inside edge on to his pads. The ball rolls to the off side.
Length and outside off, left alone.
Pakistan have lost the plot here. Shadab Khan is in now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust! Pakistan in real trouble! Nortje is turning it on for South Africa. Short and around middle. Asif Ali goes for the pull but the ball gets big on him and lobs off the higher part of the bat to deep mid-wicket where Andile Phehlukwayo takes a good catch.
Short of a length and around off, Rizwan pats it to the off side for a single.
Fuller and around off, driven straight to mid off this time by Rizwan.
Length and around off, pushed back to the bowler this time by Rizwan.
On middle, worked away with the spin to mid-wicket. Pakistan have slowed down a bit there.
Loopy on off, blocked solidly off the front foot by Ali.
Full on middle, clipped away to long on for a run by Rizwan.
WIDE! Floated but down leg, Rizwan goes for the sweep but misses it. Wide called.
Floated around off, Ali goes for a lofted hit but cannot middle it but the ball drops short of Ngidi at long off. A single taken to bring the 200 for Pakistan.
On leg, once again turned away to leg slip.
Full and on leg, Ali whips it to leg slip who fumbles but fields it in the end.
Short and around leg, hooked away to square leg for a single.
Who comes out to bat now.? It is Asif Ali who joins Mohammad Rizwan in the middle.
Who is in next?

OUT! CAUGHT! EDGED AND TAKEN! The debutant walks back disappointed. Nortje is on fire. Three overs and three wickets for him in this spell. Good pacy short ball around off, Aziz gets sucked into poking at it. He though does it tentatively but it is enough to kiss the glove which is taken by Quinton de Kock behind the wickets. South Africa are fighting back after Babar's wicket.
Short and outside off, Rizwan flat bats it to deep mid-wicket for a single now.
BEATEN! Length and around off, Rizwan pokes at it tentatively but is beaten all ends up as the ball scoots past the outside edge.
Full and around middle, worked to mid-wicket.
Length and around off, pushed to point off the back foot.
Single to end the over. Loopy ball on middle, tucked towards mid-wicket for a run.
Short and wide outside off, Danish cuts it through backward point and gets to the other end.
Aziz is up and running. It was a mishit from Aziz though. Tossed up and around off, Danish looks to hammer it over covers. Miscues it but it goes over. Two taken.
Flatter and around off, kept out.
Floated around off, blocked solidly this time.

NOT OUT! Floated on off, Aziz comes on the front foot and looks to ease it to the leg side but is beaten to get rapped on the pads. The ball; goes to the first slip where the fielder takes the catch and goes in an appeal. The umpire doesn't agree with both LBW as well as the catch. South Africa take the review and Ball Tracker shows a flat line while the Ball Tracker shows it to be missing the stumps. South Africa lose a review.

South Africa take the review! The replays come on and it is the debutant Danish Aziz in question. The Ultra Edge shows a flat line and the Ball Tracker too shows the ball to be going well over the stumps. South Africa lose the reivew.
Who is in next? It is Danish Aziz, the debutant.

OUT! CAUGHT! Both the set batsmen have been sent back to the hut by Anrich Nortje. Nortje in his previous over sent back Babar and now he sends Imam. Short and around off, Imam looks to pull it but the ball goes off the higher part of the bat. It lobs towards mid-wicket. Rabada from mid on runs to his left and takes the catch.
Full and on middle Rizwan pushes it down to mid on and takes a cheeky single this time.
Yorker on middle, Rizwan squeezes it to mid on. Well bowled and nicely played.
Length and on leg, whipped away to the leg side for a single.
Full and around off, stroked down the ground, the bowler tries to field it but deflects it to mid on for a single.
Short of a length and around off, blocked off the back foot towards the off side by Rizwan.
Loopy on off, driven down to long on for a single.
Fuller on off, flicked straight to mid-wicket.
Flighted around off, pushed through covers for a single.
Floated on leg, worked away to square leg by Imam.
Rizwan is off the mark here! Loopy on middle, Rizwan sweeps it towards deep square leg and gets a single.
Flatter and around off, Imam hammers it straight towards deep mid-wicket for a single only.
Beaten! Length and around off, Rizwan looks to force at it off the back foot but is beaten on the first ball he faced. A good over from Anrich Nortje comes to an end.
Who comes out to bat now? Mohammad Rizwan is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! 100 and gone! Nortje is all pumped up to get the centurion. Loose stroke from Babar Azam there. Length and around off, Babar just plays at it lazily and manages to get an outside edge which is pouched by Quinton de Kock to send the Pakistan skipper back. But he has done enough for his team to win from here.

There it is 100 for the Pakistan skipper. This has been a remarkable knock. Quite spectacular. 13th ODI hundred, Length and around middle, clipped through the leg side to get to his milestone does Babar Azam.
Full and outside off, Babar squeezes it to point.
Play and a miss! Short of a good length and outside off, Babar looks to take it on but fails to get bat on ball.
Length and around off, eased down to third man by Imam brings the Pakistan skipper on strike.

DRINKS! A much-needed break for South Africa as they have struggled to pick wickets. For now, it is all Pakistan at the moment. They need just 93 runs to win and with their skipper out in the middle along with Imam-ul-Haq makes it a walk in the park. But cricket is a funny game and you don't have a winner unless the last ball is bowled. So we are rooted to get the winner in this first ODI. For now, Anrich Nortje (5-0-31-0) to continue.
Shortish and around middle, Imam pulls it down to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and on middle, clipped behind square on the leg side for a single. Babar moves to 99.
FOUR! Swept and swept away to the fence. Babar is just one hit away from the three-figure score. Full and on middle, Babar gets down and sweeps it over square leg and beats the man in the deep.
THREE WIDES! Shamsi slips this one down the leg side. The keeper cannot collect either. They run two and get one more for wide.
Tossed up and outside off, pushed to the left of the short cover fielder who dives and makes a half stop. A single taken.
Flat and on middle, Azam goes back and flicks it down to deep mid-wicket for one.
Floated full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Single to end the over! 10 off the over. Short and wide outside off, hit hard to deep cover for one. 104 needed in 120 now.
Short again and on middle, Babar is not keen again.
Banged short and on middle, Babar lets it be.
FOUR! Slapped through the point now. Short and wide outside off, Azam stays back and slaps it through point and the ball races away to the fence. Babar is into the 90s now.

FOUR! Guided it. Just guided it and it raced to the third man fence. A length ball, just outside off, Babar uses the pace of the bowler and guides it down to the third man fence. He is into the 0s now.
Good length and around off, pushed to point for nothing.
Full and on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for one.

FOUR! Oh, he nearly took down his partner at the other end. Babar is on fire here. A length ball, around off, Babar picks it up and blazes it straight down the ground. Imam ducks for cover and does that well or else he would've been hit really hard. And then the ball races away to the fence. The stand moves over 150 now.
Babar would feel he missed out there. It was full and wide outside off, Babar hit it hard but straight to mid off.
Fullish and around off, played to mid on this time.
WIDE! Goes for the slower one but ends up bowling it down the leg side. Babar misses his flick. Given wide.
FOUR! BANG! Babar in the mood here. Short ball around off, Babar nails the pull and powers it down to the deep mid-wicket fence. Sensational batting from the Pakistani skipper.
Good length and outside off, hit down to sweeper cover for one.
Now he plays a loose shot. Chases a ball which is wide outside off on a good length but fails to put any bat.

FOUR! Classy stuff from Babar here. He is taking on one of the best pacer in the world and playing gloriuus strokes. A length ball around off and middle, Babar punches it through mid on and the ball races away to the fence. 150 up for Pakistan here.
In the air... safe! Short ball around off, Babar looks to pull but he is early in the shot. Ends up getting a top edge. The ball goes high in the air but lands safely near mid-wicket. Two taken.
FOUR! Whipped! Length ball around middle, Babar flicks it through mid-wicket and finds the fence in the deep.
Shortish and around middle, worked to mid-wicket for nothing.
Length ball outside off, Imam guides it to third man for a single.
Kagiso Rabada is back. 5-1-12-1 from him so far.
Length ball on leg, tucked to square leg for a single.
Full and around off, stroked past the man at covers  this time but mid off runs to his right and fields it.
Full and around off, driven through covers for a yet another couple of runs by Imam.
Swing and a miss! Short and wide outside off, Imam goes for a wild slash but misses it altogether.
FOUR! Nicely picked! Length and on the pads, Imam flicks it off his pads and into the fence at fine leg for a boundary. Poor line there from Ngidi.
Short of a good length and around off, pulled away to mid-wicket for a single.
Short of a length and outside off, punched off the back foot towards sweeper cover for a single.
Good length and around off, Babar plays it to the off side from the crease.
Short of a good length and around middle, pulled away to the leg side for a single.
Short of a good length and outside off, Babar runs it down to third man and gets a single now.
Short of a length  ball around off, Babar this time punches the ball straight to the man at point.
Length and around off, driven straight to mid off by Babar.
Short of a length ball around off, Babar runs it down to third man off the back foot and retains the strike for the next over with a single.
Good length and around off, driven to covers for a single.
FOUR! Imam gets to his fifty in some style! He is turning it on here! Length and around off, Imam creams the drive through cover-point to get to his milestone with a boundary.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Short and around middle, Imam pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Uppish but safe! Short ball around off, Imam goes for the pull but the ball takes the upper half and lobs up. But it goes over the man at mid on and they take two.
Lungi Ngidi is back on.
Fullish and just outside off, driven to mid off. Babar thought for the run but was sent back.
Length and around middle, worked towards deep mid-wicket for another single.
Slightly back of a length ball outside off, Azam cuts it square on the off side and gets a single this time.
FOUR! Elegant! Overpitched and wide outside off, Babar leans into it and then slaps it through covers to get a boundary.
Length and outside off, stroked to sweeper cover for another single by Imam.
Full and around off, slapped through covers for a single. That also brings up the 100-run stand between Babar and Imam. These two have motored the Pakistan innings brilliantly.
Full on off, stroked to mid on off the inner half of the bat by Babar.
Loopy on middle, whipped away to deep mid-wicket for a single. The partnership stands at 99 between Babar and Imam. Pakistan need 166 runs more in 27 overs.
Flatter and outside off, slapped towards cover-point for a single.
Flighted around off, slapped towards point who does well to intercept it.
Tossed up on middle and leg, clipped to mid on now.
Loopy on middle, worked towards mid-wicket for a single by Babar.
Loopy on middle, slogged away off the inner half to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Length and outside off, Babar drives it hard but straight to mid off.
Short and around middle, Imam pulls it towards deep square leg for just a single again.
Full and on middle, clipped towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Length and around off, Imam runs it down to third man off the face of the bat for only a single.
Short and around leg, Imam watches it and ducks under it.
Full and wide outside off, Imam cuts it behind point and gets a brace this time with ease. 100-up for Pakistan.
Floated around middle, Azam clips it to square leg this time.
Tossed up around off, Babar dead bats it back to the bowler.
Floated around off, Imam takes a few step towards the ball and then plays it to covers for a single.
Loopy on middle, worked around the corner for a single this time.
On middle, nudged to the leg side this time.

FOUR! Misfield! Tossed up around off, Babar drives it towards mid off where Markram misfields and allows a boundary. That also brings up the 50 for Babar Azam. A good knock so far. His 17th in the format.
Full and on the pads, clipped to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full  and wide outside off, Babar plays a free-flowing drive but straight to covers.
Length and around off, driven straight to mid on off the back foot by Babar.
WIDE! Full and down leg, Babar does not fiddle with it and leaves it all alone. WIde called.
Good length and around off, punched straight to short cover.

Good length and around off, Imam gets right behind the ball and punches it down to mid off for a single. The fielder there gets across and fields it as well as has a shy at the keeper's end but misses it.
Length and around off, Imam strokes it to point now.
Gets the single on the last ball as he drives this fuller ball down to long on.
Play and a miss! Flat and just outside off, Imam once again hangs back. This time he looks to cut but misses.
Flat and on the stumps, Imam plays this one on the back foot. Manages to get his bat down just in time to block. Very risky from Imam there.
Babar flicks this flatter ball on the pads to fine leg for a single.
WIDE! Fired down the leg side. Babar looks to flick but misses. Called wide.
Full and around middle, Imam drives it to long on and gets to the other end.
On middle, eased down to deep square leg for one.
Takes the single on the last ball. 9 off the over. Shortish and outside off, Babar rides the bounce and punches it to deep cover for one.
Good length and around off, solidly blocked back to the bowler.
Lovely ball this time. A length ball, just outside off, Babar looks to run it down to third man for a run but misses.
Fullish and just outside off, pushed to point for nothing.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries. Babar is getting into his elements now. A fullish ball on middle, Babar flicks it through mid-wicket and finds the fence. Nortje under pressure here.
FOUR! Slammed down the ground. A length ball around off, Babar slams it past the bowler and into the long off fence.
Full and on middle, flicked to mid-wicket for nothing.
On the pads, clipped behind square leg for one.
Flat and around off, Imam stays back and pokes it in front of the cover fielder for a single. Sensible batting.
SIX! TAKE THAT! Enough of blocking says Imam. Tossed up and around off, Imam kneels down and slogs this one high over the wide long on fence for a biggie.
Floated around off, pushed to the cover region.
Flat and around off, kept out.

DRINKS! So far Pakistan having been batting in their comfort zone after losing Fakhar Zaman early in the chase. The pair of Babar Azam and Imam-ul-Haq have had their share of luck but most importantly they have stayed at the crease and have already eaten up 68 runs from the target. The run-rate is not an issue for them and they know that very well. They just need to keep wickets in hand and play sensibly to get the win here. South Africa after that opening burst from their bowlers have looked a bit off-colour as they have failed to pick any further wickets. They need that to be in the game or else Pakistan could run away with it with ease.
Landed around off on a length, solidly kept out. Just 3 off the over.

Ripper! How did that not take the outside edge? And maybe the top of off. Lovely stuff. A length ball around off, Babar is beaten for the outside edge as the ball shapes just a touch. It misses the top of off by a whisker.
WIDE! Slipped down the leg side. Babar looks to flick but misses. Some excitement from the keeper but the umpire wides it.
Fuller and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Outside off on a length, run down to third man for a single.
Sharp bouncer! Imam moves out of the way.
Shortish and just outside off, guided to third man for a single.
Uppish but wide! Shortish and just around off, spinning away. Imam reaches out and carves it over backward point. Two taken.
One more single! Flat and on middle, Babar clips it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Loopy ball outside off, eased through mid off for one.
Flat and on middle, Babar goes back and nudges it through square leg for a run.
On middle, worked to mid-wicket for nothing.

Just short. Floated around off and middle, it lands and spins in. Babar looks to flick but ends up getting an inside edge. The ball goes uppishly towards the leg slip fielder but it bounces just in front of his hand.
Tabraiz Shamsi is into the attack now.
Length and on the pads, Azam plays it to the leg side for a single.
Good length and around off, pushed to mid on again.

Full and around middle, Babar pushes it past the bowler and comes running down for a single. The fielder at mid on gets across and throws the ball towards the keeper as Babar turns, runs and then dives to get inside the crease.
Full and on middle, Babar strokes it to mid on now.
Length and around off, Babar taps it past point to get a quick couple of runs. That also brings up the 50-run stand between these two.
Length ball around off, Babar taps it to covers by coming right behind the line of the ball.

A couple to end the over! Length and around off, Imam looks to break the shackles as he lofts it over mid off. It is not timed to his liking but will beat Bavuma there. A couple of runs added to the total.
Length and on the pads, clipped to fine leg for a single now. Sensible batting after getting a boundary in the over.
FOUR! Any width offered and Babar will cash in. Short of a length and around off, Babar gets the timing and placement right to put it through covers for a boundary.
Good length and angled on midlde, flicked away to mid on now.
Length and around off, Babar dead bats it from within the crease to the off side.
Length and around off, Imam runs it down to third man off the back foot for a single. 50-up for Pakistan.
Length and around off, eased towards backward point for a single. A good comeback from Nortje after being hammered for 11 runs in his opening over. Just 5 off this one.
A dot now! Length and around off, Imam taps it off the back foot towards the off side.
4 singles so far! Full and around middle, clipped to wide of mid on for a quick run by Babar Azam.
Short and wide outside off, Imam slaps it to deep extra cover for just a single this time.
Another short of a length ball on middle and leg, Babar whips it to deep square leg for a single.
Short of a length and on middle, nudged towards the leg side for a single.

FOUR! Pulled beautifully! Short and around middle, Babar gets into the act early as he pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. A good end to the over after just three singles from 5 balls but the boundary on the last ball makes it 8 off the over.
Full and on the pads, Imam gets across and then clips it through square leg for another run.
Good length and around off, Babar strokes it towards covers for a single.
Good length and around off, Azam defends it out to the off side this time.
Length and outside off, Imam looks to drive it through the off side but the ball files to third man off the outside edge. A single taken.
Length and around off, chopped to point this time by Imam.
Powerplay 2 time! South Africa can now have a maximum of 4 fielders outside the inner ring till the end of the 40th over. Andile Phehlukwayo to inaugurate this passage of play.
Short of a length and around of, blocked off the back foot to mid off. Pakistan are 37/1 at the end of the mandatory Powerplay.
FOUR! And again a boundary! This is even better! Full and around off, Babar opens the face of the bat and the drives it through the gap at cover-point as the ball races to the fence in a hurry there.
Short of a length ball around off, punched on the up but straight to point where David Miller fields it.
FOUR! Easily done! Length and around off, Babar stands tall and then flays through covers for a boundary.
Full and around off, punched down to mid off for a quick run by Imam. The fielder there has a shy at the bowler's end but misses the stumps.
Anrich Nortje is on now.
Length ball around off, clipped towards the leg side by Imam for a brace.
Dot to end the 9th over. 7 off the over. Length ball around middle, worked to the man at mid-wicket.
Around off on a length, Babar blocks it back to the bowler.

FOUR! Whipped! Nice shot. This should get the Pakistani skipper going. Fullish ball on the pads, he uses his wrists and flicks it past the diving fielder at mid on. Races away to the fence. It took Pakistan 41 balls since last boundary to score another one.
Good length and around middle, tucked through mid-wicket for one.
Good length and in the channel just outside off, Imam watches the ball and then makes a leave.
Length ball on the pads, Imam clips it off the back foot towards deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Three to end the over!

Chance! A tough chance but put down. Full and wide outside off, Babar goes for the drive but ends up getting a thick outside edge. Markram, the fielder there dives full length to his right. He gets hands to it but fails to hold on. This can bre a big miss. A single taken.
He finally gets a single. Shortish and around off, he works it towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
And again! Another decent shot but amounts for nothing. Poor from these two to be honest. You just can't keep hitting straight to the fielders. Fuller ball outside off, Imam finds the cover fielder.
Fuller and outside off, Imam once again plays a fine drive but straight to the cover fielder.
Good stroke for nothing. Length ball just outside off, pushed to point.
No, he can't as Babar gets two. Rabada bowls it a bit too straight. Babar flicks it wide of deep square leg and takes two. Good running.
A leave now! Wide outside off, slightly fuller. Babar is not keen as he shoulder arms. Can Rabada bowl his 2nd maiden over?
The ball will incease but not the run as Babar blocks this length ball just outside off towards the off side.
Shortish and just around off, punched to the fielder at cover. 13 ball 1 for the Pakistani skipper so far.
And another dot. Too many so far in this innings and these might return to bite back Pakistan. A back of a length ball on the body, Babar sits under it.
Good length and just outside off, poked to point.
Yes, he can! A short ball around middle, Imam pulls but finds mid-wicket.
Fullish and around off, solidly blocked. 5 dots in a row. Can Ngidi bowl a maiden?
Beaten! Lovely channel from Lungi. Just behind good length and angling across. Imam looks to drive but misses.

Just short! A shortish ball around off and middle, Imam looks to work it on the leg side but the ball takes the outer edge and lobs up uppishly towards backward point. The fielder there dives to his right to catch but it lands ahead of him and he stretches his hand to take it on one bounce.
Another one wide outside off, another leave from Imam.
In the channel outside off, moving further away. Left alone.
Dot again! Another fine over from Rabada. Just a run that too came as a wide. A good length delivery around off, Babar blocks off the back foot.
Good length and just outside off, punched to the off side.
Sharp bouncer just around off, Babar moves out of the way.
Shortish and around off, pushed to mid off this time.
WIDE! Slipped down the leg side. Babar lets it be. Wided.
Good length and around off, pushed to  the cover region off the back foot.
Fullish and on middle, Babar flicks it to mid on for nothing.
Dot to end the over! Just 2 off it. Around off on a length, Imam stays on the front foot and blocks.
Babar is up and running!  A short ball outside off, he hangs back and guides it to third man for a single.
Nicely bowled! Very full and around off, Babar watches it nicely and blocks.
Shortish and around middle, Imam clips it behind square on the leg side for one.
Fullish and around off, pushed onto the pitch on the off side.
Fullish and angling across. Imam lets it be.
Shortish and around off, Babar is solid in defense again. A wicket-maiden from Rabada. Just terrific.
Around off on a good length, kept out.
Babar Azam walks out to bat now.

OUT! DRAGGED ON! Rabada gets the breakthrough. A length ball wide outside off, Fakhar looks to punch it on the off side but the ball takes the bottom edge and hits the stumps. Rabada is fired up. Early success for the South Africans here.
Outside off, left alone.
Play and a miss! Shortish and just outside off, Fakhar looks to punch it over the off side but misses.
Good length ball around off, Zaman tucks it towards mid-wicket and comes down for the single. Imam sends him back.
Edgy run! Fullish and outside off, he goes for the drive but the ball takes he outside edge and goes to third man for one. 7 off the over.
FOUR! Pulled away! A short ball on off, perfect height for the Zaman to bring out the pull shot. He settles and nails it over square leg for a boundary.
Good length and around off, pushed back to the bowler this time.
Short and wide outside off, punched to the cover fielder.
Angled into the batsman from a length. This time Fakhar tucks it wide of fine leg for two.
Good line and length to begin from Lungi. Just outside off and on a length. A bit of shape for him too. Fakhar makes a leave.
Who will bowl from the other end? Lungi Ngidi it is from the other end.
Anrich Nortje to bowl from the other end.
Length ball and outside off, Imam makes a leave now. A good first over from Rabada.
Length and around off, tapped to third man for a single.
Length and around middle and leg, Zaman walks across and looks to flick but misses to get high on the pads. Optimistic appeal from the bowler but nothing from the umpire.
Fuller and around midlde, Imam strokes it down to mid on and takes a quick single to get off the mark. So are Pakistan too.
Slightly fuller and around off, Imam punches it down the ground but straight to mid off.
Perfect delivery to start! Length and in that channel around off, Imam covers his sticks and then leaves it.
